headlines.title: FlyDubai pilot describes harrowing attack in call with Indian prime minister
headlines.summary: Smit Machchhar, an Indian national, spoke from his hospital bed in Abu Dhabi, according to a video shared by Narendra Modi.

headlines.title: Ex-Harrods owner potentially trafficked women on ‘shocking’ scale, official says
headlines.summary: “The scale of potential trafficking in the Al Fayed case is deeply shocking,” said Eleanor Lyons, Britain’s antislavery commissioner.

headlines.title: Attempted hijacking sets off firestorm in Israel amid election race
headlines.summary: Supporters of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu call him “Mr. Security.” Critics said this week’s FlyDubai incident, a day after he warned of a possible attack against Israel, was another security lapse on his watch.

headlines.title: While the U.S. debates AI risks, China mandates universal training for students
headlines.summary: Beijing aims to provide artificial intelligence education in all of the country’s schools by 2030, while demand for AI-themed study tours surged this summer.

headlines.title: Bolivia arrests its attorney general after U.S. accuses him of narco corruption
headlines.summary: Authorities arrested 14 people, including four whom they said were sneaking cash out of Attorney General Roger Mariaca’s home and into an ambulance.

headlines.title: Yemeni army says nearly 500 attacks kill or wound over 1,500 Houthis
headlines.summary: Fighting intensifies across Yemen as the army says 474 attacks in 24 hours killed or wounded 1,540 Houthi fighters.

headlines.title: Gaza voters want jobs and security as Palestinian elections approach
headlines.summary: Ahead of first Palestinian national elections in 20 years, people in Gaza hope to rebuild after Israeli destruction.

headlines.title: WHO warns of ‘devastating consequences’ due to delayed aid entry into Gaza
headlines.summary: The WHO's representative in Palestine calls on Israeli authorities to 'release the pressure on medical supplies'.

headlines.title: 10 injured after car crashes into rugby supporters in Australia
headlines.summary: New South Wales police say the driver, an 18-year-old rugby league fan, has been arrested.

headlines.title: Israel could’ve ended Gaza war, freed captives sooner: Israel ex-negotiator
headlines.summary: Retired General Nitzan Alon says more captives could have returned alive and a deal was possible 'maybe a year earlier'.

headlines.title: Brazil's big political rematch: What to know
headlines.summary: Four years after President Lula narrowly defeated Jair Bolsonaro, Brazil is back at the ballot box. This time, Lula faces Bolsonaro's son, Flávio, in a high-stakes rematch.

headlines.title: As Trump's proposed arch looms over D.C., protesters pin their hopes on the midterms
headlines.summary: Democratic lawmakers, veterans and concerned citizens gathered in Memorial Circle to protest the arch Trump wants to build there. Their hopes lie primarily in a lawsuit and next month's midterms.

headlines.title: Germany's political center fights for relevance after far-right and far-left gains
headlines.summary: Centrist politicians are soul-searching after electoral gains by the far right and the far left. Today's weak coalitions, political fragmentation and dire economy echo a past that led to the rise of fascism.

headlines.title: Pro-Trump Influencer Benny Johnson is being sued for defamation by ICE protesters
headlines.summary: The lawsuit says the prominent conservative podcaster falsely claimed the protesters were assaulting ICE officers during demonstrations at an ICE facility in Illinois last year.

headlines.title: October 1 ushered in a new era in U.S. foreign aid. What's the plan? Will it work?
headlines.summary: The America First strategy asks for a Memorandum of Understanding as a condition for healthcare and development aid. It's been praised for promoting self-reliance but criticized for its conditions.

headlines.title: Washington blames UK base incident on a 'foreign actor'
headlines.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the "hands of a foreign actor" were involved in an incident in which five men were arrested on suspected explosives and terrorism offenses near a British air base used by US forces.

headlines.title: Chancay Port rides a new trade current
headlines.summary: For Santos Javier Gonzales, the deep-water mega port taking shape in his hometown of Chancay, Peru, has become part of his own story — enabling him to build a career without leaving his family behind.

headlines.title: Landmark Chinese garden takes root in England
headlines.summary: SALFORD, England — After nearly eight years in the making, a Chinese garden that authorities describe as the largest of its kind in Europe has opened in Salford, bringing a distinctive Chinese presence to the horticultural landscape of northern England.

headlines.title: Ukraine's provocations fuel tensions, Putin says
headlines.summary: MOSCOW/KYIV — Russian President Vladimir Putin said on Friday that an escalation of tensions would not achieve the outcome sought by Kyiv and could only worsen the situation in Ukraine.

headlines.title: Beijing urges Japan to honor joint political commitments
headlines.summary: Foreign Ministry spokesman Guo Jiakun urged the Japanese authorities to seriously reflect on and correct their wrongdoings and take real actions to return to the purpose and mission of the four key political documents shared by China and Japan.

headlines.title: Deleted, and left in limbo
headlines.summary: Across Bihar and West Bengal, SIR deleted the names of hundreds of thousands of voters from the electoral rolls, leaving to-be-registered voters and many lifelong participants unable to vote in the 2025 and 2026 Assembly elections. In Bihar, over 47 lakh names were removed, while nearly 91 lakh were struck from West Bengal’s lists, as affected residents and their families struggle with unclear reasons.

headlines.title: Lawyers’ group announces independent panel of ex-judges to enquire into SIR aftermath
headlines.summary: Independent panel of ex-judges to probe SIR electoral revision’s validity, methodology, and impact, with nationwide hearings and December 2026 report.

headlines.title: India standardises names of 28 places in Ladakh
headlines.summary: India standardises 28 Ladakh place names on SoI map, detailing peaks, rivers, lakes, glaciers, passes, and more for clear public recognition.

headlines.title: CJP announces Jantar Mantar protest on October 10 if CEC Gyanesh Kumar does not resign
headlines.summary: CJP threatens Oct 10 Jantar Mantar protest demanding CEC Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation, claiming peaceful action for free, fair elections amid police clashes.

headlines.title: Five workers dead, over 10 injured in a boiler explosion at a Sri City SEZ facility
headlines.summary: Five workers died and over 10 injured in a boiler explosion at a Sri City SEZ facility, with cause under investigation.

hackerNews.title: Court agrees with EFF: Utah's VPN law demands a technical impossibility
hackerNews.summary: In a win for digital rights, a federal judge has issued a preliminary injunction blocking Utah’s SB 73, the state’s draconian anti-VPN age verification law. The decision comes as EFF submitted our comments to the Utah Department of Commerce, detailing how forcing platforms to detect and block privacy-preserving tools undermines user privacy and security worldwide while demanding the impossible.
